text:
olivia: quick alert - after we toggled v2 as default some tenants briefly showed spikes routed back to v1 and triggered quota alerts. looks like the fallback window is noisy for short-lived clients.
sam: thanks. is this due to missing client header or proxy handshake flakiness?
dimitri: mixture. proxy sets a short fallback marker keyed by token hash for 10m; if the client doesn't include the version header we prefer v2 then pin to v1 for that TTL. bursts occur when clients race their initial requests.
olivia: console needs to reduce alert churn during rollout. two asks: (1) surface per-tenant fallback_ratio and recent fallback_reasons (2) mark those counts as "transient" so quota-alerts don't fire immediately.
console-ui: can add a small rollout card with columns: tenant, fallback_ratio, top_reason, hint_expires_at. question - should hint_expires_at be shown as absolute time or relative?
paula: relative is friendlier in the UI. show both in hover.
telemetry-bot: propose tags to attach to traces when proxy applies fallback: `route.fallback=transient`, `route.fallback_reason=missing_header|handshake|seqlen`, `route.fallback_ttl_s` and `route.fallback_cohort=flip-2025-07-16`. also add `alert.exempt=transient_fallback` for 1h after cohort start. sample event below in attrs string form.
sam: that works. For billing we cannot permanently exempt, but we can suppress alerts for the first hour and surface a separate metric `fallback_billing_exempt_delta` for finance to review.
dimitri: implementation detail: add a runtime flag `emit_fallback_attrs` default=false. rollout plan: enable for canary tenants -> validate aggregator respects `alert.exempt` -> flip runtime on for more tenants.
console-ui: to avoid state explosion we'll compute fallback_ratio over routed requests. we can add an optional sampled distinct-token view for heavy tenants.
olivia: also add a small inline tooltip per tenant: "Recent transient fallbacks suppressed from quota alerts until <time>. Click to see reasons."
infra-bot: deployed: routing-proxy/canary -> emit_fallback_attrs=true (staging) - 2025-07-16 02:01 UTC
paula: telemetry change: aggregator will reduce alert score by 0.85 when `route.fallback=transient` AND `rollout_age_s < 3600`. we'll also write sampled debug traces to s3://telemetry-debug/fallbacks/YYYYMMDD with 7d retention.
sam: QA plan: generate synthetic clients that omit header, ones that send delayed headers, and ones with long seq lengths. assert `route.fallback_ttl_s` present and that quota alerts remain suppressed post flip for 1h.
telemetry-bot: schema for trace attrs (string list form): ["route.policy=prefer-v2","route.selected=v1","route.fallback=transient","route.fallback_reason=handshake","route.fallback_ttl_s=600","route.fallback_cohort=flip-2025-07-16","alert.exempt=transient_fallback","telemetry.sample_rate=0.02"]
console-ui: I'll add the rollout card and tenant tooltip in staging. API will return `hint_expires_at` and `hint_note`. Example: `{"hint_note":"transient fallback due to handshake flakiness","hint_expires_at":"2025-07-16T03:01:00Z"}`.
paula: once staging looks good, promote to 10% canary and watch `fallback_ratio`, `distinct_token_fallbacks`, `billing-alert-rate`. if billing-alert-rate doesn't drop, revert suppression.
olivia: thanks. please post results in this thread. if any tenant shows >5% sustained fallback for 10m we pause the flip and investigate.
infra-bot: routing-proxy/staging emitting fallback attrs for tests - 2025-07-16 02:12 UTC
paula: note for docs - add a short blurb under rollout best practices: "During version flips we suppress transient fallback counts from quota-alerting for 1 hour. Use the rollout dashboard to inspect per-tenant reasons and reset fallback markers if needed."
sam: also add console action: "reset fallback markers" that calls proxy debug endpoint `POST /admin/tenants/{id}/clear_fallbacks`.
olivia: perfect. will monitor. thanks team :rocket:
